description.ja: TVアニメ『ドラゴンボール超』に登場の超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人孫悟空がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！マッスルをビルドせよ！
description.en: Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Son Goku from the TV anime “Dragon Ball Super” has been released with a renewed package! ! Build muscle!

description.ja: • 超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人の特徴の青く輝く頭髪はメタリックの成形色で再現！
description.en: • Super Saiyan God The shining blue hair that characterizes Super Saiyan is reproduced in metallic molding color!

description.ja: • 表情パーツには「平常」・「叫び」の２種類が付属。
description.en: • Two types of expression parts are included: "normal " and " screaming".

description.ja: • エフェクトパーツには「かめはめ波(ため)」と「かめはめ波(解放)」の２種が付属。
description.en: • Two types of effect parts are included: "Kamehameha (Tame)" and " Kamehameha (Release)".

description.ja: • 劇中内で着用する胴着の「悟」マークを再現するホイルシールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a foil seal that reproduces the "Satoru" mark on the body worn in the play.

accessories.ja: 必殺技エフェクト2種（かめはめ波〈ため〉、かめはめ波〈解放〉）×各1

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ5種（左右握り手、左右かめはめ波手、瞬間移動手）×各1
